component.name: HomeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.top.backgroundURI = "" m.top.backgroundColor = "0x0A0A0AFF"
' Title bar m.title = m.top.findNode("titleLabel") m.status = m.top.findNode("statusLabel")
' Channel grid m.channelList = m.top.findNode("channelList") m.channelList.observeField("itemSelected", "onChannelSelected")
' Keep focus on scene root until content loads m.top.setFocus(true)
' Load channels from backend (async via Task) m.backendBase = "https://broadcaster.emergent.host" m.status.text = "Loading channels..." loadChannels() end sub
sub loadChannels() m.channelLoader = CreateObject("roSGNode", "DataFetcher") m.channelLoader.url = m.backendBase + "/api/channels" m.channelLoader.observeField("response", "onChannelsLoaded") m.channelLoader.control = "RUN" end sub
sub onChannelsLoaded() ok = m.channelLoader.success body = m.channelLoader.response if not ok or Len(body) = 0 m.status.text = "Network error. Unable to reach broadcaster.emergent.host" return end if data = ParseJson(body) if data = invalid or type(data) <> "roArray" m.status.text = "Server returned invalid data (parse failed)" return end if
content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") m.channels = [] for each ch in data if ch.videos <> invalid and ch.videos.Count() > 0 m.channels.Push(ch) item = content.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = ch.name item.description = (ch.videos.Count()).ToStr() + " videos" if ch.thumbnail <> invalid and Len(ch.thumbnail) > 0 item.HDPosterUrl = ch.thumbnail item.SDPosterUrl = ch.thumbnail end if end if end for m.channelList.content = content m.status.text = "Select a channel | Press * for TV Guide | Loaded " + m.channels.Count().ToStr() + " channels" ' Now transfer focus to the grid m.channelList.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onChannelSelected() idx = m.channelList.itemSelected if idx < 0 or idx >= m.channels.Count() then return openPlayer(m.channels[idx]) end sub
sub openPlayer(channel as Object) player = m.top.createChild("LivePlayer") player.channel = channel player.backendBase = m.backendBase player.setFocus(true) player.observeField("closed", "onPlayerClosed") end sub
sub openGuide() guide = m.top.createChild("TVGuide") guide.backendBase = m.backendBase guide.channels = m.channels guide.setFocus(true) guide.observeField("closed", "onGuideClosed") guide.observeField("selectedChannelIndex", "onGuideChannelPicked") end sub
sub onGuideChannelPicked() guide = getGuideNode() if guide = invalid then return idx = guide.selectedChannelIndex if idx < 0 or idx >= m.channels.Count() then return channel = m.channels[idx] removeGuideNode() openPlayer(channel) end sub
sub onGuideClosed() removeGuideNode() m.channelList.setFocus(true) end sub
function getGuideNode() as Object for i = 0 to m.top.getChildCount() - 1 child = m.top.getChild(i) if child.subtype() = "TVGuide" then return child end for return invalid end function
sub removeGuideNode() for i = m.top.getChildCount() - 1 to 0 step -1 child = m.top.getChild(i) if child.subtype() = "TVGuide" m.top.removeChild(child) end if end for end sub
sub onPlayerClosed() ' Return focus to grid m.channelList.setFocus(true) for i = m.top.getChildCount() - 1 to 0 step -1 child = m.top.getChild(i) if child.subtype() = "LivePlayer" m.top.removeChild(child) end if end for end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if press if key = "back" m.top.exit = true return true end if if key = "options" or key = "info" ' Open TV Guide openGuide() return true end if end if return false end function
